Senses.Explanation: The last small measure of breath keeping a person alive appears in death warnings and sickbed verse. Two addresses say it is cut off at death, one verse says gruel prolongs it, and another contrasts its absence with remaining appearances. One referent covers both breath ending and breath prolonged.
